title: Approve Soft product standard layout
question: World is locked: Soft product standard. Which composition should we build for the group map?

options.label: Classic map + soft sidebar
options.thesis: Map dominates left; quiet sidebar for stats/friends; Log trip obvious — familiar and clear.
options.viewport: Top bar · map 70% · soft right panel · Log trip · soft toast

options.label: Full map + bottom bar
options.thesis: Maximum map; controls float in a soft bottom bar — more immersive, still minimal.
options.viewport: Full-bleed map · thin top · floating bottom bar with Log trip

options.label: Map + slim left rail
options.thesis: List/rail on the left for places & friends; map stays open — good for scanning names.
options.viewport: Slim left rail · map · Log trip in rail · slim discovery banner
